adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the mutation persists new attendees via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)` before calling `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);`. That calendar update is not wrapped in `try/catch` or a DB transaction, so if it throws, the TRPC mutation errors while the DB write has already succeeded. On a subsequent retry, `uniqueGuests` is computed by filtering out emails already present in `booking.attendees`, so it can become empty and the handler throws `BAD_REQUEST` with `emails_must_be_unique_valid`, which is misleading and also means the calendar update + email sending may never complete for those already-persisted guests.
